summary.headline: Defense of Astrology
summary.text: A defense of astrology argues that God created all things, including heavenly and starry bodies, for human benefit, distinguishing legitimate astrological study from impious star worship, incantations, and invocations. The passage explains the life-giving effects of the sun and moon on plants, animals, fish, and human activity.
